description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Find the quality alert titled "Incorrect Spacing Between Components" and enter the following text in the Corrective Action field: "Recalibrate all assembly jig spacing templates to design specification. Inspect and re-work all affected units from the current batch. Issue corrective action request to supplier for non-conforming components. Conduct re-training session for assembly operators on spacing tolerance requirements." Save the record.
